note: class-upgrade graph + per-class stats. cxp_limit=mastery to be class-up-ready; param_req=stat gate to enter (id->min); resource_cost=paid to change into this class. Stats are raw class-table values (pre level-variance/affinity/homegrown).

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: Basic Infantry. Front line warrior who can provide cover. Has the most options for growth into other unit types.

drakeling.name: Drakeling
drakeling.description: A child dragon with basic fire breath. In time, will mature in a formidable adult.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: A young adult dragon, breathes fire in a wide swath. Can specialize into more advanced dragons.

reddragon.name: Red Dragon
reddragon.description: A mature dragon specializing in powerful fire breath. May learn how to become a Red Dragon Rider.

bluedragon.name: Blue Dragon
bluedragon.description: A mature dragon specializing in powerful lightning breath. May learn how to become a Blue Dragon Rider.

silverdragon.name: Silver Dragon
silverdragon.description: A mature dragon specializing in powerful ice breath. May learn how to become a Silver Dragon Rider.

reddragonrider.name: Red Dragon Rider
reddragonrider.description: The ultimate evolution of the Red Dragon, it can now take to the skies and deliver devastating fire breath.

bluedragonrider.name: Blue Dragon Rider
bluedragonrider.description: The ultimate evolution of the Blue Dragon, it can now take to the skies and deliver devastating lightning breath.

silverdragonrider.name: Silver Dragon Rider
silverdragonrider.description: The ultimate evolution of the Silver Dragon, it can now take to the skies and deliver devastating ice breath.

militia.name: Militia
militia.description: Basic Infantry. Can be part of a Light Squad, who specialize in rough terrain and ambushes.

bowman.name: Bowman
bowman.description: Basic Archery unit. Can attack from 2 tiles away.

medic.name: Medic
medic.description: Basic Support unit. Able to provide healing in and out of battle.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: Front line Heavy Infantry. Heavily armored, and protects back lines with Cover.

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description: Front line Heavy Infantry. Polearms are strong against Cavalry.

cavalier.name: Cavalier
cavalier.description: Basic Heavy Cavalry. Heavily armored, and protects back lines with Cover.

acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.description: Heavy Infantry. Deals Striking damage. Gets a bonus to Magic Defense from a portion of her Armor.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.description: Basic Light Infantry. Can Ambush, and gets a significant SKL bonus while fighting in Rough terrain.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Basic Light Cavalry. Can Ambush, and is strong against enemy Cavalry.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Specialized Light Infantry. On offense, will execute a Stealth attack, striking the back row.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Standard Archery unit. Can attack from 2 tiles away. Has the potential to upgrade to a class with 3 tile range.

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.description: Specialized Archery unit. Can attack from 2 tiles away, and gets a bonus against Heavy troops.

horsebow.name: Horsebow
horsebow.description: Light Cavalry Archer. Can fire from 2 tiles, ambush, and hit-and-run.

swordfighter.name: Swordfighter
swordfighter.description: Standard Light Infantry. Very strong attack, but sacrifices almost all defense.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.description: Basic Magician unit. Launches a Fire elemental magic attack with a small area effect.

priestess.name: Priestess
priestess.description: Standard Support unit. Able to provide healing in and out of battle, with much greater ability than the Medic.

siren.name: Siren
siren.description: Specialized Magician unit. Launches a Dark elemental magic attack that has a chance to stun and/or daze the target.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.description: Powerhouse defensive Heavy Infantry. Uses a polearm and has a special defense against Firearms attacks.

champion.name: Champion
champion.description: Powerhouse Heavy Infantry. Executes a double-attack against a single enemy.

zweihander.name: Zweihander
zweihander.description: Specialized Heavy Infantry. Attack hits a wide-arc, striking the units adjacent to the target in the same row.

centurion.name: Centurion
centurion.description: Specialized Heavy Infantry. The ultimate Polearm attacker, whose attacks strike the units behind the target.

samurai.name: Samurai
samurai.description: Versatile Heavy Infantry. Possesses the Polearm skill of a Spearman with the bow attacks of an Archer. 35% More base Evasion than other Heavy classes.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: Specialized Heavy Infantry. Deals Striking damage. Gets a bonus to Magic Defense from a portion of her Armor, and deals extra damage to Magicians. Can heal self or ally under 50% HP once per battle.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Powerhouse Heavy Cavalry. Has a special defense against Archery attacks.

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.description: Versatile Heavy Cavalry. Brings the healing ability of the Hospitaller, but can now attack in battle and execute Charge attacks.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Specialized Light Infantry. Can Ambush, and gets a significant SKL bonus while fighting in Rough terrain, and can fire a precision bolt.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: Specialized Light Infantry. On offense, will execute a Stealth attack, striking the back row, with much greater ability than the Rogue.

hussar.name: Hussar
hussar.description: Powerhouse Light Cavalry. Can Ambush, and is strong against enemy Cavalry, with much greater ability than the Scout.

warbow.name: Warbow
warbow.description: Powerhouse Archery unit. Can attack from up to 3 tiles away.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: Powerhouse Light Cavalry Archer. Can fire from 2 tiles, ambush, and hit-and-run, with much greater ability than the Horsebow.

templar.name: Templar
templar.description: Ultimate Support unit. Able to provide healing in and out of battle, with the greatest possible proficiency.

hospitaller.name: Hospitaller
hospitaller.description: Specialized Support unit. Able to provide healing in and out of battle, with the mobility of Cavalry.

firemage.name: Fire Mage
firemage.description: Powerhouse Magician unit. Launches a powerful Fire elemental magic attack that hits the entire target Row.

icemage.name: Ice Mage
icemage.description: Specialized Magician unit. Launches an Ice elemental magic attack that hits a large area of effect, and inflicts Chill on targets.

lightningmage.name: Lightning Mage
lightningmage.description: Powerhouse Magician unit. Launches a powerful Lightning elemental magic attack that hits the entire target Column.

sorceress.name: Sorceress
sorceress.description: Specialized Magician unit. Launches a Dark elemental magic attack that hits a large area of effect, with a chance to inflict Stun and Daze.

gunner.name: Gunner
gunner.description: Standard Firearms unit. Attacks are extremely powerful and bypass almost all Armor.

dragoon.name: Dragoon
dragoon.description: Specialized Firearms unit. Attacks are extremely powerful and bypass almost all Armor. Has the mobility of Cavalry.

siegecannon.name: Siege Cannon
siegecannon.description: Specialized Firearms unit. Can only attack on offense. Launches a powerful barrage from up to 3 tiles away.

swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
swordmaster.description: Powerhouse offensive Light Infantry. Executes a powerful double-attack.

swordmaster2.name: Blademaster
swordmaster2.description: Powerhouse offensive Light Infantry. Executes a powerful double-attack. Attacks with a bow at 2+ range.

titan2.name: Exemplar
titan2.description: Diana's smaller form, with the same abilities as the Titan.

arbalest.name: Arbalest
arbalest.description: Archery class that fires 3x slightly weaker bolts and resists enemy ranged attacks.

warcat.name: Warcat
warcat.description: Light Infantry Large Beast that attacks in a wide arc. Increased Critical chance during Night.

behemoth.name: Behemoth
behemoth.description: Upgrade to War Cat that gains the ability to bypass blocking when attacking from high ground to lower ground.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Magician that steals life to heal themselves and allies. Summons Risen. Greatly increases Unlife Essence accumulation.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.description: Support class that casts a shield on all allies at the start of battle.

fieldcannon.name: Field Cannon
fieldcannon.description: Firearms. Can only attack on offense. Attacks from up to 3 tiles away. Cavalry movement type.

darkmage.name: Dark Mage
darkmage.description: Magician class that attacks in a large area. Lowers effectiveness of heals, Mage and Dragon attacks.

queenofdragons.name: Queen of Dragons
queenofdragons.description: Abigayle's ultimate form. Flying unit. Can heal allies, and use a powerful breath attack.
